arguments.sql: WITH main AS (SELECT s."Region Name", s."Year", 100.0 * s."Industrial Water Consumption (100 million m³)" / s."Total Water Consumption (100 million m³) " AS ind_share, e."Per capita GDP (yuan/person)" AS pc_gdp FROM sheet1 s JOIN economic_indicator_data e ON s."Year" = e."Year" AND s."Region Code" = e."Region Code" WHERE s."Region Name" != 'China' GROUP BY s."Region Name", s."Year"), stats AS (SELECT "Region Name", COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(ind_share) AS sx, SUM(pc_gdp) AS sy, SUM(ind_share * pc_gdp) AS sxy, SUM(ind_share * ind_share) AS sx2, SUM(pc_gdp * pc_gdp) AS sy2 FROM main GROUP BY "Region Name") SELECT "Region Name", ROUND((n * sxy - sx * sy) / SQRT((n * sx2 - sx * sx) * (n * sy2 - sy * sy)), 4) AS corr_share_gdp, ROUND(sx/n, 2) AS avg_share FROM stats ORDER BY corr_share_gdp DESC
